channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran war live: Blasts heard in Qeshm; US moves to block land supply routes
item.description: Iranian state media report blasts on Qeshm Island in Strait of Hormuz and the cities of Jask, Sirik and Bandar Abbas.

item.title: Masked protesters set off firecrackers and block roads in Albania
item.description: Police used water cannons to disperse masked protesters in Albania’s capital, Tirana.

item.title: Yemeni gov’t forces report advances as Houthis say deadly strikes hit Sanaa
item.description: Civilians bear the brunt of fighting as 27 people reported killed in strikes on a village in Sanaa province.

item.title: Houthis report 25 killed in Yemen strikes
item.description: Yemen’s Houthis say at least 25 people have been killed and 30 injured in air strikes.

item.title: Lebanese footballer refuses to give up after injuries from Israeli strike
item.description: After surviving an Israeli airstrike that left her in a coma, Celine Haidar is back on the pitch, coaching footballers.

item.title: What we know so far after Krakow gun attack
item.description: Six people were killed in a random shooting in the city's main square, and three bodies were later found at his home.

item.title: Israel's president tasks opposition leader Eisenkot with forming government
item.description: Neither PM Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc nor that of his rival secured a majority in last week's election.

item.title: US offers $20m reward for information about Iran's nuclear programme
item.description: Donald Trump has repeatedly raised the prospect of renewing strikes against Iran's nuclear facilities.

item.title: Houthis say at least 25 killed in Saudi air strike
item.description: Saudi Arabia, which leads a coalition fighting the Houthis in Yemen, has not commented.

item.title: Spain's rail authorities face European fraud probe after Urda rail disaster
item.description: Prosecutors begin investigating EU funds meant for upgrading the Spanish railway line where a train crash killed 69 people.
